subject: HelioMed renewal — vendor onboarding refresh & procurement portal next steps
messages:
From: Anna Rhodes <anna.rhodes@heliomed.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal / vendor onboarding: HelioMed 2029 renewal & procurement portal question

Hi Marcus,

Hope you’re well. Our renewal for Redwood is scheduled for Jan 31, 2029 and procurement asked us to refresh vendor onboarding before we can raise the PO. Two quick asks: 

- Can you provide the current SOC2 Type II summary and any evidence package your procurement portal expects (certs, attestation, contact for security questionnaire)?
- We also need an updated SOW showing the committed capacity (we plan to increase seats by ~25% starting Feb) and any billing thresholds/PO guidance so we can route correctly in our system.

Procurement also wants to know whether Redwood will accept our standard PO terms or if we need a DocuSign SOW amendment. If you can share a one-page onboarding checklist and a direct procurement-portal link we’ll upload the vendor packet on our side.

Thanks — I’ve looped procurement (procurement@heliomed.com) on this thread.

Best,
Anna Rhodes
Senior Procurement Manager
HelioMed

Attachments: none (they asked us to request the docs from you)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Rhodes <anna.rhodes@heliomed.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal / vendor onboarding: HelioMed 2029 renewal & procurement portal question

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and clear asks. Welcome the renewal and the planned 25% capacity bump — congrats on the expansion. I’ve put together the materials below and an initial mutual action plan to accelerate your procurement onboarding.

What I’m attaching / linking:
- SOC2 Type II summary (filename: SOC2_TypeII_summary_2027.pdf) and short FAQ about evidence we typically surface.
- A compressed evidence bundle with certificates and audit contact stub (vendor-evidence-pack.zip).
- Draft SOW amendment showing the seat increase and a model billing cadence (I’ve left the PO threshold field blank for you to confirm).
- Direct procurement portal link: https://redwood-procure.example.com/portal/HelioMed-12345 (upload zone: "Vendor Evidence -> Renewals")

Immediate asks for HelioMed procurement:
1) Confirm billing contact & PO routing (AP email and PO approval owner).
2) Tell us whether your legal requires us to redline the SOW or accept an amendment via DocuSign.
3) If you have any specific security questionnaire (SIG, CAIQ), send it and I’ll rope in our security team.

Proposed MAP (timeline):
- Day 0 (today): Materials uploaded to portal by Redwood and shared with you.
- Day 2: HelioMed uploads vendor packet + confirms PO routing.
- Day 5-7: Legal review / SOW redline (if required).
- Day 10: PO issuance / DocuSign and billing onboarding.

Deal metadata: HLMD-2028-004 — I’ve set our billing team to prioritize this as a renewal + expansion. If procurement needs a temporary credit hold while evidence is validated, let me know and we can escalate.

I’ve attached the files to this email. If it helps, we can run a 20-minute screen-share tomorrow to walk procurement through the portal upload flow.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Lead — Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_summary_2027.pdf (pdf), vendor-evidence-pack.zip (zip)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Anna Rhodes <anna.rhodes@heliomed.com>
Date: 2028-12-01T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal / vendor onboarding: HelioMed 2029 renewal & procurement portal question

Thanks Marcus / Anna — quick legal checklist from my end: 

- I attached a one-page SOW amendment draft for the 25% seat increase (SOW_amendment_draft.docx). Please confirm the effective date (we’ve used 2029-02-01) and whether HelioMed needs any custom data-residency clauses.
- For procurement: we typically accept a PO referencing the SOW number; if HelioMed requires exceptions to our standard terms (limitation of liability cap, indemnity, or data deletion SLA), please flag now so we can prepare a short exception matrix.
- On the PO threshold: if AP wants staged PO processing, we can support a top-level PO (annual commit) + incremental POs for top-ups. Recommend a 90-day window for staged top-ups to avoid constant reissuance.

I’m attaching the SOW amendment draft for HelioMed review. Marcus — if procurement confirms they’ll upload, I’ll prepare a redline template and a DocuSign envelope to speed sign-off.

On quoting: assuming the 25% seat increase and current unit rates, we estimate the new annual commit to increase ~24% — Jasmine, I’ll rely on you to confirm the final quote to include in the SOW.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_amendment_draft.docx (docx)

We uploaded everything to your portal (confirmed upload ID: HELMD-UP-20281202-77). Procurement will route the PO to our AP owner (ap@heliomed.com) and expects to issue the PO by next Wednesday (2028-12-06). They also asked for the DocuSign envelope once the SOW amendment is finalized — here’s the procurement ticket if you need to reference it: https://procure.heliomed.com/tickets/56821.

One remaining ask: can Redwood’s billing team accept invoices referencing an external PO number (their standard) and the SOW number together? If yes, procurement will include both on the PO and we should be good.

Appreciate the offer to screen-share — procurement would like that. Can we do 30 minutes on Tue 12/05 at 10:00 PT?
